cockpit_baseline.label: Cockpit current release v1.3.27
cockpit_baseline.evidence_note: Public GitHub releases v1.3.25, v1.3.26 and latest v1.3.27 confirmed on 2026-08-23; Codex-only parity scope preserved.

capabilities.label: Codex multi-account management
capabilities.notes: HMS account pool exists; real Windows account lifecycle still pending.

capabilities.label: Codex isolated multi-instance
capabilities.notes: HMS has isolated instance/fleet/session layers; target-PC runtime certification pending.

capabilities.label: Hourly/weekly quota + plan recognition
capabilities.notes: HMS has quota history/metadata, but live fidelity across OAuth/PAT/Team remains runtime gap.

capabilities.label: Named local client API keys
capabilities.notes: Digest-only key store; plaintext shown only at creation.

capabilities.label: Per-key model allow/deny + prefix
capabilities.notes: v24 adds model prefix exposure/rewriting plus existing allow/deny.

capabilities.label: Auto/random/single/quota/plan/expiry/custom routing
capabilities.notes: v24 closes current Cockpit routing-mode gap.

capabilities.label: Priority/weight/backup routing
capabilities.notes: Can be overridden per client key.

capabilities.label: Per-key target/account pool
capabilities.notes: HMS extension: each client key can have its own target subset.

capabilities.label: Fresh quota reserve fail-closed
capabilities.notes: Requires real quota metadata feed for production.

capabilities.label: Session affinity + cooldown/failover
capabilities.notes: Affinity is client-key scoped in v24.

capabilities.label: Models/chat/responses/backend Codex generic HTTP surface
capabilities.notes: HMS generic relay covers paths; exact real-Codex compatibility remains target-PC gate.

capabilities.label: Responses WebSocket relay
capabilities.notes: Synthetic handshake/relay/failover PASS.

capabilities.label: Image endpoint compatibility
capabilities.notes: Generic relay exists, but no dedicated image-tool mapping/concurrency scheduler in HMS yet.

capabilities.label: Local CORS preflight
capabilities.notes: Loopback-origin allowlist by default.

capabilities.label: Daily/week/month/all usage by account/model/key
capabilities.notes: Trace-derived analytics; token coverage depends on upstream usage fields.

capabilities.label: Custom model pricing + estimated value
capabilities.notes: No hard-coded possibly stale prices; operator supplies pricing.

capabilities.label: Request ID/account/retry/timing diagnostics
capabilities.notes: HMS also captures TTFT/bytes/protocol telemetry.

capabilities.label: Backup/restore managed Codex profile
capabilities.notes: HMS safety architecture exists but needs explicit Windows runtime proof.

capabilities.label: Session/history visibility repair
capabilities.notes: HMS Session Doctor backs up session metadata and repairs known state_5.sqlite thread provider fields.

capabilities.label: Advanced timeout/retry/stream controls
capabilities.notes: Some Cockpit presets/controls remain richer in UI.

capabilities.label: Proxy fail-closed egress
capabilities.notes: HMS Proxy Fleet is deeper than baseline proxy-url handling.

capabilities.label: Public-IP baseline/drift/quarantine
capabilities.notes: HMS-specific control-plane extension.

capabilities.label: HA + Soak + Policy Kernel
capabilities.notes: v25.47 resumable soak harness synthetic PASS; real 6h/24h Windows soak still pending.

capabilities.label: Windows source/runtime evidence gates
capabilities.notes: HMS-specific certification layer; real target-PC gate has not been executed.

capabilities.label: Performance / scale + bounded backpressure
capabilities.notes: v25.48 synthetic/local control-plane benchmark PASS; real Codex model TTFT and Windows scale evidence remain deferred.

capabilities.label: Real Codex target-machine certification harness
capabilities.notes: v25.49 harness/validator PASS; build host is non-Windows without live Codex, so real target-machine certification is explicitly deferred.

capabilities.label: Last-good quota freshness + plan reserve fail-closed
capabilities.notes: v25.50 synthetic gate PASS; real Free/Plus/Pro quota fidelity on Windows remains target-machine evidence and does not increase parity score.

capabilities.label: Seamless rotation torture regression gate
capabilities.notes: v25.51 1000-cycle synthetic rotation torture is a regression/safety gate only; it does not increase production parity without target-machine evidence.

capabilities.label: Target-machine production certification aggregator
capabilities.notes: v25.53 aggregator/negative validator PASS; production score remains unchanged until its real Windows/Codex/quota/failover/LAN/6h/24h evidence itself returns PASS.

capabilities.label: Unified operator UX + route/quota decision surface
capabilities.notes: v25.52 native + loopback read-only Unified UX exposes route eligibility, hold/stale reasons, active route and local filters while preserving the frozen public backend contract.

capabilities.label: Deterministic production digital twin + fault injection
capabilities.notes: v25.54 multi-seed/replayable control-plane simulation exercises quota/429/crash/auth/backpressure/SMB/LAN/clock-skew but never increases production evidence score.

capabilities.label: Autonomous router large-pool digital twin + bounded model checking
capabilities.notes: v25.55 32-account/12-instance/24-project twin + 3,072-state bounded checker + minimized counterexample; synthetic-only and does not increase production evidence.

capabilities.label: Protocol chaos / API compatibility fuzzer
capabilities.notes: v25.56 deterministic SSE/WebSocket/JSON/chunked/retry/EOF fuzzing plus gateway integrity hardening; synthetic-only and does not increase production evidence.

capabilities.label: Cause-aware recovery planner + self-healing decision proof
capabilities.notes: v25.57 cause-aware bounded recovery, rollback proof, loop breaker and 9,216-state safety checker; synthetic-only and does not increase production evidence.

capabilities.label: Compound-fault recovery DAG + global convergence proof
capabilities.notes: v25.58 compound-fault DAG/global budget with 72,960-state convergence checker to HEALTHY/DEGRADED_SAFE/OPERATOR_REQUIRED; synthetic-only and does not increase production evidence.

capabilities.label: Official Codex auth compatibility / account switching
capabilities.notes: v25.59 established Cockpit v1.3.24 auth semantics; v25.70 re-baselines compatibility to Cockpit v1.3.27 while retaining file/direct-keyring/auto semantics, pre-switch snapshot, serialized field-preserving rewrite, stale-credential cleanup, version-derived Codex identity and controlled restart; encrypted Secrets backend is detected/fail-closed until an official Codex helper is available.

capabilities.label: Crash-consistent recovery transaction journal
capabilities.notes: v25.60 durable hash-chain PREPARE/COMMIT/VERIFY/DONE-or-ROLLBACK journal prevents duplicate auth rewrite/restart/lease reelection after crash; synthetic-only and does not increase production evidence.

capabilities.label: Native Usage & Token Center parity+
capabilities.notes: v25.61 read-only plan/quota/reset/package-expiry/OAuth-lifecycle interpretation, source/freshness and scenario-only after-reset preview; synthetic/control-plane evidence only and does not increase production evidence.

capabilities.label: Multi-subsystem recovery transaction replay
capabilities.notes: v25.62 idempotent replay/verification and reverse-DAG compensation across auth/restart/router/LAN effects with operator-required fail-closed convergence; synthetic-only and does not increase production evidence.

capabilities.label: Startup recovery reconciler
capabilities.notes: v25.63 cold-start journal discovery, metadata/digest-only external observation and mutation preflight gating; target Windows/Codex live observation remains required.

capabilities.label: Target-machine crash injection harness foundation
capabilities.notes: v25.63 executes real subprocess kill/cold-start recovery in a lab state model, but real Codex effects and Windows target-machine evidence are explicitly not claimed.

capabilities.label: Live Windows recovery observer bridge foundation
capabilities.notes: v25.64 observer/evidence contracts are validated without claiming a live Windows target run; real target evidence remains required.

capabilities.label: Controlled real-effect crash certification contract
capabilities.notes: v25.64/v25.65 real-effect mode remains DISARMED by default and cannot directly promote production score.

capabilities.label: Target recovery evidence bundle
capabilities.notes: Target evidence bundle is an attestation candidate only; bundle presence alone never certifies production.

capabilities.label: Windows Target Adapter Pack
capabilities.notes: v25.65 structured-argv adapters expose digest/idempotency witnesses only; synthetic/control-plane validation does not increase production score.

capabilities.label: Attested Evidence Promotion Gate
capabilities.notes: v25.65 centralizes promotion eligibility behind nonce/run/package/signer/freshness/hash-chain and complete 4x3 crash-matrix validation. No target attestation is bundled in this release.

capabilities.label: Vietnamese Recovery Operator Timeline
capabilities.notes: v25.65 metadata-only Vietnamese timeline improves operator evidence visibility and is non-benchmark control-plane evidence.

capabilities.label: Windows-local cryptographic attestation signer
capabilities.notes: v25.66 validates DPAPI/certificate signing contracts and cryptographic verification using safe fixtures; no Windows target signing was executed in this build.

capabilities.label: One-shot controlled target certification runbook
capabilities.notes: v25.66 locks dry-run/preflight/operator arming/auto-disarm workflow; target mode remains disarmed and requires real Windows integration.

capabilities.label: Privacy-safe attestation export/import and Vietnamese promotion explanation
capabilities.notes: v25.66 verifies bundle integrity/privacy and explains promotion decisions without making automatic production certification claims.

capabilities.label: Windows attestation trust store / certificate lifecycle
capabilities.notes: v25.67 certificate pinning/rotation/revocation plus DPAPI lifecycle metadata and deterministic trust snapshot; control-plane evidence only.

capabilities.label: Offline trust-snapshot attestation verifier
capabilities.notes: v25.67 verifies package/signature/trust state without account credentials or network; synthetic certificate fixture does not raise production score.

capabilities.label: Resumable 4x3 target certification campaign
capabilities.notes: v25.67 one-shot per-case campaign journal resumes via VERIFY_ONLY/ATTEST_ONLY/OPERATOR_REQUIRED and never silently repeats durable effects.

capabilities.label: Windows-only one-case target campaign executor
capabilities.notes: v25.68 binds one explicitly armed case to frozen manifest/trust snapshot, Windows/PS5.1/Codex observer preflight and idempotency witness; synthetic proof never executes real effects.

capabilities.label: Attested 12-case promotion review console
capabilities.notes: v25.68 reviews exactly 12 signed reports with freshness/revocation/mixed-version checks and Vietnamese human-review decision; no automatic production certification.

capabilities.label: Read-only Windows target certification evidence ingest
capabilities.notes: v25.69 verifies cryptographic binding/replay/trust/package/campaign state and quarantines invalid imported reports without executing target effects or auto-repair.

capabilities.label: Append-only dual-review promotion decision ledger
capabilities.notes: v25.69 hash-chained reviewer decisions require two distinct pseudonymous reviewers and superseding invalidation entries; promotion eligibility remains separate from production score mutation.

capabilities.label: Cockpit Tools v1.3.27 Codex parity reset
capabilities.notes: v25.70 resets the competitive baseline from Cockpit v1.3.24 to v1.3.27 and audits the Codex-only changes from v1.3.25-v1.3.27 without weakening HMS transactional/fail-closed guarantees.

capabilities.label: Cockpit v1.3.27 source-level parity integration
capabilities.notes: v25.70 integrates runtime foreign-port rebind, launch-time account occupancy, client/API split state, official-account-ref usage continuity, bounded credential backups, WebSocket preservation, composite conversation identity and live-only model context metadata. Windows runtime proof remains pending.

capabilities.label: Cockpit v1.3.27 Windows runtime parity certification
capabilities.notes: v25.71 defines seven target cases bound to external Windows/Codex signed evidence. Synthetic validation proves the gate contract only; windows_runtime_certified remains false until external evidence is imported.

capabilities.label: Production evidence promotion proposal auditor
capabilities.notes: v25.71 re-verifies runtime certificate, dual-review chain and current Cockpit baseline, then may propose human review only. It never mutates production score or auto-certifies.

capabilities.label: Portable Windows target evidence capture kit
capabilities.notes: v25.72 packages seven one-case target capture flows with exact ZIP/manifest/Codex binding, privacy-safe signed reports and DISARMED default. Real Windows execution remains external.

capabilities.label: Cockpit public baseline watch and promotion freeze gate
capabilities.notes: v25.72 freezes target campaign/promotion whenever public Cockpit is newer than 1.3.27 and requires a Codex-only delta audit before continuing.

capabilities.label: Seven-case Windows target evidence import review
capabilities.notes: v25.73 verifies the seven v25.72 runtime-parity reports with exact package/manifest/trust/signature/replay/freshness binding and dual-review ledger semantics; synthetic fixtures never certify Windows runtime.

capabilities.label: Two-checkpoint Cockpit baseline delta watch automation
capabilities.notes: v25.73 rechecks Cockpit before import and before promotion review; any newer public baseline freezes promotion and queues Codex-only delta audit without auto-merge.

capabilities.label: Immutable external Windows evidence review packet
capabilities.notes: v25.74 derives a privacy-safe hash-chained review packet from seven target report digests and pseudonymous append-only review metadata; raw evidence is never normalized in place or embedded.

capabilities.label: Baseline drift eligibility invalidation and capability reuse reconciliation
capabilities.notes: v25.74 freezes review packets on newer Cockpit baselines, generates superseding INVALIDATE ledger entries, and allows evidence reuse only after Codex-only capability binding plus a new dual-review epoch; no silent grandfathering.

interpretation.feature_score: Evidence-weighted implementation/parity score, not a benchmark of real throughput.
interpretation.production_score: Penalizes synthetic/static-only evidence. It is intentionally much lower until Windows runtime gates pass.
interpretation.no_superset_claim: HMS must not be called a production superset until the v25.49 live target-machine Real Codex gate, v25.50 real Free/Plus/Pro quota fidelity gate, v25.51 target-machine rotation torture, v25.52 UX target-machine review and the v25.53 seven-stage real target-machine certificate pass. v25.54 simulation, v25.55 autonomous-router model checking, v25.56 protocol chaos fuzzing, v25.57 recovery decision proof, v25.58 compound-fault convergence proof, v25.59 official-auth compatibility fixtures, v25.60 crash-consistent recovery journal proof, v25.61 Usage & Token Center proof, v25.62 transaction replay proof, and v25.63 startup-recovery/crash-lab proof, v25.64 Windows-observer/real-effect contract proof, and v25.65 adapter/attestation/promotion/timeline proof plus v25.66 cryptographic signer/runbook/exchange proof and v25.67 trust-store/offline-verifier/resumable-campaign proof plus v25.68 one-case executor/promotion-review proof and v25.69 evidence-ingest/dual-review-ledger proof and v25.70 Cockpit-v1.3.27 parity reset/source-integration proof plus v25.71 Windows-runtime-certification/promotion-auditor contract proof and v25.72 portable target-capture/baseline-watch proof plus v25.73 seven-case import-review/two-checkpoint baseline-delta-watch proof and v25.74 immutable-review-packet/baseline-drift-reconciliation proof are explicitly non-production evidence until real Windows/Codex evidence is imported, cryptographically validated, dual-reviewed and separately audited for production-score promotion.
